source_lead: The only DR 82 board in this directory whose free listing links out dofollow, and the price is three real comments plus their badge on your site.
eligibility:
You need A live site with an English version A domain rating above zero Their badge in your header or footer Three thoughtful comments on other launches A square logo and at least three gallery images You'll be rejected if A site with no English version A domain rating of zero Refusing the badge, which is the whole price of the free lane
Indie products SaaS products AI tools Marketing tools Newsletters
youNeed: A live site with an English version A domain rating above zero Their badge in your header or footer Three thoughtful comments on other launches A square logo and at least three gallery images
submit_steps: 1 Take the free lane from the pricing page /submit shows four tiers. The free one is the plain card on the left, and its button says Submit under the words "Free with embed badge".
2 Leave three comments A counter on /launch tracks them. Their rule is thoughtful and specific, and "Looks cool" is named as the thing that will not count.
3 Put the badge up and verify Copy either badge, deploy it, tick the conditions box and press Verify Badge. It answers Verification Passed and turns the button into Next.
4 Fill the launch, in five screens Name and tagline, three topics, description, features and use cases, then a square logo and at least three gallery images, then pricing, makers and competitors.

5 Pick a date and decline the upsells The last screen wants a launch date before its button lifts. Submitting lands on an upsell page with Premium at $49 pre-ticked; untick it and the button says Submit.
submit_requirements: A description, a features list and a use-cases list
Gallery images three or more at 1200x628
One category and topics one category, up to three topics
A launch date, which their form will not let you skip
A maker comment to open the thread optional
rejection_reasons: A site with no English version A domain rating of zero Refusing the badge, which is the whole price of the free lane
gotchas: The free listing's outbound link carries rel="noopener" and no nofollow, which their own pricing never says. The paid tiers sell a "guaranteed high-authority backlink" that the free tier already gives you.
The badge is not a courtesy. Their crawler checks for it before the launch form will open, and the free tier is described in their own words as "free with embed badge".
Three comments come before the form, not after, and they reject generic ones. Budget the time to actually read three other launches.
Their badge URL contains a doubled slash, /api/v1//public/badges/, which is correct and will 404 if you tidy it.
Every paid extra is pre-ticked for you: the $99 add-ons on the way in and Premium at $49 on the way out. Untick before each Submit or the button quietly becomes a checkout.

The site is bot-protected, so the first load shows a security check and the guessable submit path returns a 404.

source_lead: A 300-tool SaaS and AI directory where the free dofollow listing costs you a permanent badge instead of money. Requirements, steps and what to expect.
eligibility:
You need A live, working product Ahrefs DR 5+ for the free tier Their badge on your site, kept permanently (free tier) You'll be rejected if Crypto, adult, gambling, drugs, weapons or illegal services Landing pages for unlaunched ideas Clones without meaningful differentiation
SaaS tools AI tools Indie products Directories
youNeed: A live, working product Ahrefs DR 5+ for the free tier Their badge on your site, kept permanently (free tier)
submit_steps: 1 Pick the free plan Three tiers on /submit. Free needs DR 5+ and the badge; a browser confirm dialog restates the terms before the form opens.
2 Fill the product form URL, name, a 256-character description, a 500 to 2,000 character markdown introduction, categories and pricing tags. No account needed.
3 Upload media A 1:1 logo and a 16:9 screenshot, PNG or JPEG, 1MB each. Uploads fire only after badge verification.
4 Place and verify the badge Paste their snippet on your site, then click Verify Backlink. Their bot fetches your page live; the badge must stay up forever or the listing is delisted.
5 Submit past the upsell The Submit button opens a premium upsell modal every time; Continue with Free is the actual submission click.
submit_requirements: A live product URL checked against Ahrefs before the form opens
A permanent badge their snippet, rel="dofollow"
Categories one or more, from their list
A product logo 1:1, PNG or JPEG, max 1MB
A product screenshot 16:9, PNG or JPEG, max 1MB
An X or LinkedIn link optional
rejection_reasons: Crypto, adult, gambling, drugs, weapons or illegal services Landing pages for unlaunched ideas Clones without meaningful differentiation
gotchas: The free tier's domain-rating floor is 20, not the 5 it used to be. Their own line is that they raised it "due to the quality of our products and the high volume of interest", and it is checked against Ahrefs at step two, before the form will open at all.
Badge removal means automatic delisting; their bot re-crawls your site on a schedule.
Submitting needs three ticks, and one of them is agreeing to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, so the last click is a person's whether or not everything else was filled by an agent.

The logo and screenshot are accepted into the form but not uploaded until the badge verifies: both preview under the words "Will upload after badge verification", so a run that stops before the badge leaves no assets behind.
